Chapter 352 - 352 Apologize; Introduction!

352 Apologize; Introduction!

When President Liu heard this, his eyes narrowed slightly. Just as he was about to say something, his gaze was suddenly attracted by a young man in a checkered shirt.

President Liu changed his arrogant appearance from before. He lowered his head like a pug and respectfully called out, “Hello, Young Master Wu.”

Originally, Young Master Wu did not pay attention to them.

However, when he heard someone calling him, he still turned around politely.

When he saw President Liu, Young Master Wu’s expression did not change much.

However, in the next moment, his pupils suddenly constricted.

Then, he quickened his pace and walked forward.

It was because he saw Lin Fan!

Young Master Wu was the groom of the wedding held at Qing Kun Hotel on the eve of the spring festival, Wu Kai!

He would never forget how respectful and fawning all the big shots were toward Lin Fan.

At the same time, he could not forget that Lin Fan was a major shareholder of Qing Kun Group, a major shareholder of Xiao Wu Wholesale City, and the owner of the Imperial Hotel!

Ever since the wedding, Wu Kai had been fantasizing about when he would be able to chat with Lin Fan and build a relationship with him.

Unfortunately, he had never had such an opportunity.

Wu Kai did not expect that he would encounter it today!

…

President Liu, who had a beer belly, saw Young Master Wu walking toward him. His fat face revealed a hint of surprise.

One had to know…

Young Master Wu’s father was a big shot in Qing City.

If he had a relationship with him, it would definitely be a great thing for him.

President Liu saw that Wu Kai was getting closer and closer, so he quickly flattered, “Young Master Wu, you…”

However, before he could finish, Wu Kai said in a very respectful tone, “Mr. Lin, long time no see.”

Lin Fan had a photographic memory, so he naturally remembered the groom from the wedding banquet.

At this moment, Lin Fan was in a bad mood.

Wu Kai saw that Lin Fan did not reply. His eyes moved slightly, and his gaze landed on President Liu who was beside him.

He had a vague impression of President Liu. After thinking about it carefully, he seemed to remember this man.

Wu Kai then remembered that the other party had toasted him when he went to a hotel for dinner once… His surname seemed to be Liu?

“Mr. Lin, do you know Mr. Liu?”

Lin Fan glanced at President Liu and said, “Yeah, I know him…He owes Uncle Xue money for a few carts of meat. He even threatened to teach me a lesson!”

Initially, Wu Kai thought that Lin Fan and President Liu were close.

He could use this to build a connection and get closer to Lin Fan.

However, what was the situation now?

This Liu guy actually dared to owe Lin Fan’s uncle money and even threatened him?!

Threatening a major shareholder of Qing Kun Group?

Threatening the major shareholder of Xiao Wu Wholesale City?

Threatening the owner of the Imperial Hotel?

He… How dare he?!

More importantly, his words just now actually showed that he seemed to be somewhat familiar with this Liu fellow!

Thinking of this, Wu Kai’s expression darkened as he shouted sternly, “Liu, you really have guts!”

President Liu stuttered, “Y-Young Master Wu…I…”

Wu Kai saw that he wanted to explain to him instead of apologizing to Lin Fan immediately. A wave of anger rose in his heart. At the same time, in order to cut ties with President Liu as soon as possible, he kicked him to the ground.

“F*ck!” he shouted.

Plop!

This kick finally woke President Liu up.

“M-Mr. Lin… I’m sorry, I didn’t recognize you… I looked down on others… I’m sorry…”

However, no matter how much President Liu cried and apologized, Lin Fan’s expression remained the same. There was no change at all.

Then, President Liu crawled a few steps forward and said, “Old… Old Xue, I’m sorry. I’m a bastard. I shouldn’t have owed you money for the meat… I’ll send the money to you right away. What’s your account number? I’ll transfer the money to you now.”

President Liu kept kowtowing, then hugged Xue Baoguo’s pants and wailed.

Xue Baoguo had no choice but to take out his bank card.

President Liu held the bank card as if he was holding a life buoy. He quickly took out his phone and entered a string of numbers.

Holding onto a life buoy.

In fact, there was nothing wrong with this!

That was because President Liu knew very well how terrifying Wu Kai’s power was.

If Wu Kai wanted to push him into a dead end, it would not take much effort at all.

As for Mr. Lin, who even Wu Kai had to treat respectfully…

What kind of power did he have?

Yet he actually threatened him?

Just thinking about it made President Liu feel a wave of fear in his heart, and his face turned pale.

At this moment, he was filled with regret.

Why did he owe the money for the meat?

In less than a minute, Xue Baoguo’s phone vibrated.

[Notice from Hua Nation Construction Bank: 1,000,000 yuan was deposited into your account.]

When Xue Baoguo saw the text message, he was slightly stunned and said, “One… A million? You only owe me 389,200 yuan, Mr. Liu. You gave me too much.”

“It’s not too much…” President Liu hurriedly said.

Seeing that Xue Baoguo still wanted to say something, Lin Fan said, “Uncle Xue, just take it. He has owed you money for the meat for so long. Take it as interest.”

“Yes, it’s interest…” President Liu added.

Xue Baoguo opened his mouth as if he wanted to say something.

In the end, he did not speak.

When President Liu saw this, he heaved a sigh of relief.

Then, he looked at Lin Fan carefully.

Lin Fan said calmly, “I don’t want something like this to happen again. Do you understand?”

President Liu said excitedly, “I understand, I understand…”

“Get lost,” Lin Fan said.

“Yes, yes… Thank you, Mr. Lin. Thank you, Old Xue. Thank you, Young Master Wu.” After President Liu finished speaking, he quickly ran into the distance.

After he left, the scene became much quieter.

“Uncle Xue, how many carts of meat did you send to President Liu?” Lin Fan asked. “Are you in the meat business now?”

Xue Baoguo was still a little confused.

However, he still answered, “Yes.”

At this moment, hurried footsteps sounded not far away.

“Mr. Lin!” The chairman of Qing Kun, Li Wannian, who was dressed in a suit, called out respectfully.

Lin Fan said, “You came at the right time. My Uncle Xue is in the meat business. The hotel, supermarkets, and other businesses in Qing Kun should also need pork and beef, right? In the future, you can source them from my Uncle Xue.”

Li Wannian did not understand what had just happened.

However, since Lin Fan had opened his mouth, there was no problem at all.

Li Wannian took the initiative to extend his hand to Xue Baoguo. “Mr. Xue, we’ll have to rely on you in the future.”

The pork and beef of Qing Kun Group would be provided by him?

Xue Baoguo’s mind was in a daze again.

However, he still reached out and shook Li Wannian’s hand out of reflex.

Lin Fan introduced, “Uncle Xue, this is the chairman of Qing Kun Group, Li Wannian. If you need anything in the future, just look for him.”

“What?” Xue Baoguo widened his eyes in shock.
